stages.message: PICK UP THE KIDS AND GO TO KRUSTYLU BEFORE KRUSTY LEAVES
FOLLOW THE MOVIE TRUCK TO FIND KRUSTY'S LIMO
RACE KRUSTY'S LIMO TO THE SQUIDPORT
DRIVE TO THE BREWERY BEFORE THE TRUCKLOAD OF LASERS LEAVES
HIT THE DUFF TRUCK AND DESTROY THE LASER BOXES
FIND A LASER GUN, TO USE AS PROOF

missions.title: Duff for Me, Duff for You

stages.message: DESTROY PRINCIPAL SKINNER'S CAR AND RECOVER THE LASER GUN
DESTROY ALL OF THE LASER STANDS
GET THE "GLOBEX SUPER VILLAIN CAR."   KEARNEY IS AT KRUSTYLU STUDIOS
RACE THE ALIENS TO THE DUFF BREWERY
DRIVE TO THE KRUSTY BURGER BY THE ANDROID'S DUNGEON
COMPLETE ALL LAPS AND FINISH FIRST
PASS ALL CHECKPOINTS AND FINISH FIRST
COMPLETE AN ENTIRE LAP BEFORE TIME RUNS OUT
DESTROY CHIEF WIGGUM'S CAR AND COLLECT THE EVIDENCE
